description: An Amazon Comprehend custom entity recognizer: a trained model that identifies custom entity types in text, created via an asynchronous training job.

EntityRecognizerInputDataConfig.description: Specifies the format and location of the input data for an entity recognizer.

DataFormat.description: The format of your training data.

EntityTypes.description: The entity types in the labeled training data.

Documents.description: The S3 location of the folder that contains the training documents.

Annotations.description: The S3 location of the CSV file that annotates your training documents.

EntityList.description: The S3 location of the CSV file that has the entity list.

AugmentedManifests.description: A list of augmented manifest files that provide training data for a custom model.

EntityTypesListItem.description: An entity type within a labeled training dataset that Amazon Comprehend uses to train a custom entity recognizer.

Type.description: An entity type within a labeled training dataset.

EntityRecognizerDocuments.description: Describes the training documents submitted with an entity recognizer.

S3Uri.description: Specifies the Amazon S3 location where the training documents are located.

TestS3Uri.description: Specifies the Amazon S3 location where the test documents are located.

InputFormat.description: Specifies how the text in an input file should be processed.

EntityRecognizerAnnotations.description: Describes the annotations associated with an entity recognizer.

S3Uri.description: Specifies the Amazon S3 location where the annotations are located.

TestS3Uri.description: Specifies the Amazon S3 location where the test annotations are located.

EntityRecognizerEntityList.description: Describes the entity list submitted with an entity recognizer.

S3Uri.description: Specifies the Amazon S3 location where the entity list is located.

AugmentedManifestsListItem.description: An augmented manifest file that provides training data for your custom model.

S3Uri.description: The Amazon S3 location of the augmented manifest file.

Split.description: The purpose of the data you've provided in the augmented manifest.

AttributeNames.description: The JSON attribute that contains the annotations for your training documents.

AnnotationDataS3Uri.description: The S3 prefix to the annotation files that are referred in the augmented manifest file.

SourceDocumentsS3Uri.description: The S3 prefix to the source files (PDFs) that are referred to in the augmented manifest file.

VpcConfig.description: Configuration parameters for an optional private Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) containing the resources you are using for the job.

SecurityGroupIds.description: The ID number for a security group on an instance of your private VPC.

Subnets.description: The ID for each subnet being used in your private VPC.

Tag.description: A key-value pair that adds metadata to a resource.

Key.description: The key of the key-value pair that forms a tag.

Value.description: The value of the key-value pair that forms a tag.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the entity recognizer.

RecognizerName.description: The name given to the entity recognizer.

VersionName.description: The version name given to the entity recognizer.

DataAccessRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that grants Amazon Comprehend read access to your input data.

LanguageCode.description: The language of the input documents. All documents must be in the same language.

InputDataConfig.description: Specifies the format and location of the input data. The S3 bucket containing the input data must be located in the same Region as the entity recognizer being created.

VolumeKmsKeyId.description: ID for the AWS KMS key that Amazon Comprehend uses to encrypt data on the storage volume attached to the ML compute instance(s).

ModelKmsKeyId.description: ID for the AWS KMS key that Amazon Comprehend uses to encrypt trained custom models.

VpcConfig.description: Configuration parameters for an optional private VPC containing the resources you are using for your custom entity recognizer.

ModelPolicy.description: The JSON resource-based policy to attach to your custom entity recognizer model.

Tags.description: Tags to associate with the entity recognizer.
